The '''Technician Droid TE''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A number of those droids were used to defend the factory during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />
